scheme_name: Bharati Scheme for Education - Professional Education Course
other_conditions: Student and parents must belong to the Brahmin community
Student must be enrolled in any recognized and reputed college anywhere in India
Parents must be residing in Andhra Pradesh
Student must have cleared all subjects of the previous year
Student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
Student must not have availed any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose
Students benefiting from Archaka Welfare Trust are also eligible
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 per academic year for professional education courses.
